name: MiniGallery
audience: A bored student in class looking for something to do.
promise: Something more interesting to look at instead of zoning out in class.
headline:
Zoned out?
Look at this instead.
summary: A tiny gallery for the back row. One interesting thing to look at, right now.
design_direction: Gallery-wall calm with a cheeky twist: lots of white space, one bold color, the art comes first.
